blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
In trade, payment is everything. Three tiny words make a big difference: on, in, and by.

We say payment on Friday. We say the contract starts in March. We say we need payment by Monday. On is for a day. In is for a month. By is for a deadline.

Today we learn five words and these three little prepositions. Clear terms, clear mind. Organised time is trust built.

items.q: In trade, what is "everything"?
items.why: "In trade, payment is everything."

items.q: Which preposition is for a day, like Friday?
items.why: "payment on Friday" — on é para o dia.

items.q: Which preposition is for a month, like March?
items.why: "the contract starts in March" — in é para o mês.

items.q: The text says "organised time is trust built." This suggests that…
options: Time is not important in trade
Clear dates help people trust you
items.why: Inferência: tempo organizado constrói confiança — datas claras geram confiança.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: Small words like on, in, by matter a lot
Payment terms are easy to ignore
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que essas três palavrinhas fazem grande diferença.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Ethan revisar os prazos de pagamento com o novo trader. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team. Let me review the payment terms with you. They are simple, but very important.

Our terms are thirty days. This means the client has thirty days to pay. The payment is due on the fifteenth of the month. Not the tenth, not the twentieth. On the fifteenth.

The client pays by bank transfer. Not by cash, not by check. By bank transfer only. The money arrives in two or three days. So please, do not worry on day one. It is normal.

Remember the three words. On is for a day. In is for a month or a number of days. By is for a deadline. On the fifteenth, in March, by Monday.

If you write the terms clearly, the client trusts us. Clear terms, clear mind. Any questions? Good. Let's start.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What are the payment terms?
items.why: "Our terms are thirty days."

items.q: When is the payment due?
items.why: "The payment is due on the fifteenth of the month."

items.q: How does the client pay?
items.why: "The client pays by bank transfer."

items.q: Why does Ethan say "do not worry on day one"?
options: Because the first day is a holiday
Because the money takes a few days to arrive
items.why: Inferência: o dinheiro chega em dois ou três dias, então é normal não ter nada no primeiro dia.

items.q: What does Ethan think is important for trust?
items.why: Inferência: "If you write the terms clearly, the client trusts us."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We received the payment this morning." A payment is…
items.why: Payment = pagamento, o dinheiro que é pago.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Our ___ are thirty days to pay."
items.why: Term = prazo / condição. "Our terms are thirty days."

items.q: "The invoice is due on Friday." Due means…
options: to be paid on that date
items.why: Due = a vencer; o pagamento deve acontecer nessa data.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The money is in the ___, so we can pay now."
items.why: Bank = banco, onde fica o dinheiro.

items.q: "The client pays by bank transfer." A transfer is…
options: moving money from one account to another
items.why: Transfer = transferência; mover dinheiro de uma conta para outra.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem quando falamos de pagamentos. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the payment." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "Please follow up on the late invoice." To follow up on means to…
options: check it again to make sure it is done
items.why: Follow up on = dar seguimento, verificar de novo.

items.q: "We need to set up the bank transfer." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = configurar, preparar, organizar.

items.q: "The client is running late with the payment." This means the payment is…
items.why: Running late = atrasado, chegando depois do prazo.

items.q: "Let's go over the payment terms one more time." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, repassar.
